name: How long does it take to remove an interior wall?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to remove an interior wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for interior wall removal depends on the wall's complexity and scope of work. A non-load-bearing wall without utilities might be removed in one to three days, including cleanup. If the wall is load-bearing and requires structural modifications (like installing a beam) or extensive utility rerouting, the project could extend to a week or more. This timeframe includes the demolition, structural work, and initial finishing like drywall patching.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removing a non-load-bearing wall can take 1-3 days. Load-bearing walls with structural work or utility rerouting may take a week or more.
